name: H5 DC - Portland

profile.reading: This H5 Data Centers facility is located at 1233 NW 12th Avenue, Suite 201, Portland, Oregon 97209. The building totals approximately 42,000 square feet, with N+1 UPS power, 48 hour diesel runtime generator backup, and N+1 CRAC cooling, per the operator own facility page. The facility connects to 8 on net carriers and the Northwest Access Exchange. No total MW capacity figure is published for this specific building.
